notes: Recorded 211 bachelor's, 317 master's and 192 doctoral lines from five universities. Per university (bachelor/master/doctoral): Sun Yat-sen University: 90/116/105; Beijing Language and Culture University: 15/56/17; University of Shanghai for Science and Technology: 47/25/14; Northeast Normal University: 31/78/40; Changsha University of Science and Technology: 28/42/16.

Sun Yat-sen University: the full PDF was read (313 rows: 90 bachelor's, 118 master's, 105 doctoral). The earlier pass skipped rows whose name cell wraps onto two lines; they are included now. Two repeated master's names in the PDF (Nursing; Urban and Rural Planning appear twice with identical length and language) are stored once, so 116 distinct master's lines are recorded. Two names are wrapped two-line cells in the PDF and are kept as printed: Human Geography Urban and Rural Planning (bachelor's) and Rehabilitation Physiotherapy (master's and doctoral).

Sun Yat-sen University: the PDF has no faculty column; it gives only level, major, teaching language and length. Nearly all are Chinese-taught; the English-taught ones are the master's and doctoral majors Nuclear Science and Technology, Physics, Space Physics and Atmospheric Sciences.

Beijing Language and Culture University: all 88 rows of the attachment are recorded (15 bachelor's, 56 master's, 17 doctoral). Several names break across two lines in the Excel file with the connecting word missing (for example Curriculum / Methodology, Comparative Literature / World Literature, Foreign Linguistics / Applied Linguistics); they are recorded as printed, joined with a space.

University of Shanghai for Science and Technology: the sheets are titled 47 bachelor's, 25 master's and 14 doctoral CSC-A majors. The workbook also contains two bachelor's majors (Advertising, Product Design) and two master's majors (Mechanics (Engineering), Software Engineering) marked as no longer enrolling from 2026; these four are left out. Animation is marked as planned to stop in 2027 and is kept, with a note. Master's rows sit under first-level disciplines; only the major name is recorded.

Northeast Normal University: every row of both PDFs has a tick in the CSC Type A column (31 bachelor's majors; 151 master's and doctoral rows, which become 118 distinct major-and-level lines once the Chinese-taught and English-taught versions of a major are merged into one line).

Changsha University of Science and Technology: the government notice says all the university's programmes are open to Type A applicants and gives the list as an attachment. It has 141 rows (47 bachelor's, 73 master's, 21 doctoral); rows for the Chinese-taught and English-taught versions of the same major are merged, giving 28 bachelor's, 42 master's and 16 doctoral lines.

Participating universities not covered: Jilin University (list behind a captcha), and the many other universities in the Type A programme whose lists are not published as readable documents or could not be opened (see fetch_problems). The stored programmes are therefore a large part of, but not the whole, set of majors a Type A holder can take across China.
A major can be offered by several universities; rows are one per university. Durations and teaching languages are the universities' own figures.
not_stated: A national list of majors open to all Type A holders (each university decides what it offers).
Faculty or school for the Sun Yat-sen University, Beijing Language and Culture University and Changsha University of Science and Technology rows (their lists have no faculty column).
fetch_problems: Jilin University: the Catalog of Majors for International Students is an attachment behind a captcha download page; it was not bypassed, so no Jilin majors are recorded.

Beijing Foreign Studies University, Shanghai University of Finance and Economics, Shanghai International Studies University, Northwest A&F University, Tsinghua University, East China University of Science and Technology and China University of Petroleum (Beijing): their pages give no list of majors for Type A (they cover Type B or refer to the home-country authority), so nothing was recorded for them.
Zhejiang University: the Type A page asks for a login. Peking University: the Type A page returned content not found.
The CSC catalogue of universities and majors is a JavaScript-only search and was not used.
